link_preview.title: Bass OS - Android x86_64, Raspberry Pi & VirtIO Kiosk OS
link_preview.description_html: Bass OS is a product-focused Android OS for x86_64 PCs, Raspberry Pi 4/5, VirtIO VMs, and Linux via Waydroid/Submix-built for kiosks, POS, digital signage, tablets, and custom hardware.
